text: Then, by what means is it ceased? When there is knowledge of the twenty-five elements: [recognizing] the characteristics of Sattva and Purusha as described, [and knowing] "this is Pradhana, this is Buddhi, this is Ahankara, these five are the subtle elements, these eleven are the senses, and these five are the great elements," and [realizing] that the Purusha is distinct and dissimilar from all these. Thus, through this knowledge, the signs [of bondage] are removed, and from that follows liberation.
